- feat: build-release.ps1 fully automatic — no prompts, auto version bump, auto commit
- feat: build-release.ps1 auto version bump, changelog, full automation
- chore: versions.json final download_url for v1.0.1
fix: remove UTF-8 BOM from versions.json, write all files BOM-free
fix: opt into Node.js 24 for GitHub Actions to silence deprecation warning
feat: flat ZIP structure - extract to public_html, visit domain, installer starts
feat: add Download cPanel button to landing page — auto version from versions.json
fix: read download_url from versions.json entry directly — no version mismatch
fix: remove php_value directives from .htaccess — incompatible with LiteSpeed
fix: auto-detect app root + auto-chmod in index.php — zero manual cPanel work
fix: PHP 8.2 version gate + vendor check in index.php — shows friendly error instead of blank 500
fix: add HTTP to HTTPS redirect in .htaccess
fix: redirect to install.php instead of require — isolates installer errors from root URL
debug: enable PHP error display to diagnose 500 error
fix: remove HTTPS redirect from .htaccess — LiteSpeed was rejecting and removing entire file
debug: empty .htaccess + phptest.php to isolate 500 cause
docs: rewrite README — separate cPanel vs dev requirements, clarify Node.js is dev-only
debug: add exception handler to show exact PHP error instead of blank 500
fix: redirect to installer if .env missing or APP_KEY empty — prevents MissingAppKeyException
fix: require install.php directly instead of redirect — LiteSpeed routes all requests through index.php
fix: clear stale .installed flag if .env missing — prevents redirect loop on reinstall

fix: graceful update_history table handling + remove temp migration file

- UpdateController now catches missing update_history table and returns
  empty history instead of 500 error (existing installs without the table)
- Deleted public/run-migrations.php (temp one-time script, security risk in prod)
- New installs from ZIP will have the table via migration automatically

fix: stop auto-seeding USER sidebar menus; move all nav to DEVELOPER section

Problem: DefaultSidebarMenuImporter was creating 7 menu items (Dashboard,
My Apps, Marketplace, etc.) in the USER category automatically — items the
admin never added, causing confusion in the Menus management UI.

Changes:
- Remove seedUserMenus() entirely. USER category is now a blank canvas;
  admins populate it manually via Menus UI when needed.
- Expand seedDeveloperMenus() with the full navigation set: Dashboard,
  My Apps, AI Builder, Marketplace, Templates, AI Knowledge, Menus,
  Menu Categories, Settings (9 items, all platform navigation).
- app.blade.php: hide USER sidebar section entirely when it has no items.
- app.blade.php: lazy-seed now only triggers when DEVELOPER menus are
  empty (USER being empty is the expected default state).
